about: Manifest of the held-out data-v7 of the native tool task (#1088, R-1088-14, R-1088-16; #1171). Tool: artefacts.py. `data` pins the version: one tag of the private Hugging Face dataset repository, and the commit the tag points at. Every file comes from the version (version_path) and is placed under data/v7/, where crates/assist-eval reads the val set and the worlds by default; the sha256 is of the bytes in place. data-v7 is no longer rebuilt, and a new data version is made only by `cargo run -p centraid-datagen -- build --version vN`.
